fields.quote: No, we collect payment up front

notes: The pricing page has a Monthly/Yearly toggle; each plan shows the monthly price and, for yearly billing, the struck-through monthly price followed by the discounted monthly equivalent (Starter $29 -> $25/mo, Email Outreach $49 -> $45/mo, Sales Engagement $99 -> $85/mo). No yearly total is displayed. Prices are per user ('Billing is paid by your team and is based on how many users you purchase'). Agency Plan has no price ('Talk to Sales'). Data Finder ($19/$17 per month) and Ready to Use Mailboxes ($12/$11 per month) are add-ons, not plans. No free trial ('we collect payment up front'). 'Trusted by sales teams at 100,000+ companies' / 'Trusted by 100,000+ sales teams' and the case-study revenue figures (SaaSMQL $1M+, New Reach Marketing $800K) are company-stated, not payment proof. Footer 'Affiliate Program' link and a reviewer titled 'Partner' are incidental: the core product is cold email / sales outreach automation, eligible.
